profile_text.body:
# Amazon

Amazon is a public company founded in 1994 and headquartered in Seattle, Washington, United States.

The site's harvested content was minimal. According to the registry, Amazon has four Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers available: ai.sellermate/amazon-ads for querying Amazon Ads accounts with OAuth authentication, ai.trendsapi/amazon and ai.trendsmcp/amazon for product search volume and demand trends, and app.apiguru/amazon-data for live product, review, search, deal, and seller information across 20 marketplaces.

Amazon appears in litigation: the held facts reference Haugland v. Anthropic PBC in the District Court, D. Delaware. The company is exposed to legal matters in Washington state, with 96 cases tracked in that jurisdiction.
